the as-obtained PMo12-Pts/rGO composite can be considered as a novel catalyst for direct methanol fuel cell (DMFC) applications.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the POMs clusters not only act as the modifier to enhance the electrocatalytic performance of Pt, but also act as the catalyst to oxidize the methanol to CO2.

the PMo12 clusters can act as an effective modifier on the rGO to enhance the electrocatalytic performance of Pt nanoparticles, and the electrochemically reduced rGO could serve as an efficient support for the Pt nanoparticles to prevent their agglomeration and improve their stability.
a novel H3POMs modified Pt/rGO composite can be facilely synthesized and it shows enhanced electrocatalytic performance toward methanol oxidation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PMo12 cluster could not only improve the dispersion of Pt nanoparticles on the rGO, but also increase the electrochemically active surface area of Pt.
the PMo12 cluster could act as a modifier to enhance the catalytic activity of the Pt/rGO catalyst, which is attributed to the synergistic effect of the POMs cluster and the Pt nanoparticles.
the PMo12/Pt/rGO composite is a promising electrocatalyst for direct methanol fuel cell (DMFC).
